title: Google Search Console (GSC) Organic Insights & Indexation
overview: Google Search Console monitors organic search performance, indexing health, mobile usability, and search query trends to inform paid media keyword discovery and landing page quality.
coreConcepts: Search performance metrics: Clicks, Impressions, CTR, Average Position
Index Coverage reports: Valid, Excluded, Error, and Warning statuses
Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) impacting landing page experience quality scores
URL Inspection tool for real-time live indexing and schema validation
features: Search Console API for automated daily query and page performance queries
Sitemap submission and crawl status monitoring
Rich results test for structured data (FAQ, Product, LocalBusiness schema)
bestPractices: Cross-reference high-performing organic queries with Google Ads Search negative and target lists
Identify landing pages with poor Core Web Vitals to prevent Quality Score decay in paid ads
Monitor indexing status of key promotional and campaign landing pages
Submit dynamic XML sitemaps updated in real-time as new products launch
policies: Google Search Essentials (formerly Webmaster Guidelines) compliance
Prohibition of cloaking, doorway pages, and keyword stuffing
Domain property verification via DNS TXT record for full root and subdomain tracking
limitations: Performance data retention limited to last 16 months
Anonymized queries excluded by Google to protect user privacy (high-tail volume missing)
API quota: 1,200 requests per minute and 100,000,000 queries per day
commonIssues: Landing pages excluded with 'Crawled - currently not indexed' status due to low content quality
Discrepancies between GSC clicks and GA4 organic session counts
Failing Core Web Vitals (INP > 200ms) on ad landing pages

troubleshootingGuide.issue: High impression organic queries with poor position (> 15)
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Evaluate query commercial intent and launch targeted Exact Match Google Ads campaigns to capture demand immediately

troubleshootingGuide.issue: Slow ad landing page causing poor Quality Score
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Inspect PageSpeed Insights recommendations and compress hero images or defer non-critical JS tags
